title: Overdetermined problem for optimal transportation
summary: In this paper, we establish symmetry results for solutions of overdetermined problems arising in optimal transportation. These problems involve the Monge-Ampère equation with a Dirichlet boundary condition $u=0$ on $\partial Ω$ and the natural boundary condition $Du(Ω)=Ω^{*}$. We show that symmetry holds when the target is the unit ball $B$. For more general target domains, including the cases $Ω^*=Ω$ and arbitrary $Ω^{*}$, symmetry is retained under an additional volume constraint on $Ω$ and a boundary condition on $|Du|$.
